title: June 2026: Keep student safe, track their growth, and provide better follow-ups
summary: Our June 2026 updates are here, with alignment analytics, flexible moderation, improved follow-ups, and more.
body_markdown:
This month, we've made it easier to keep students safe, track their growth, and get insights from Sparky. You can now customize moderation with flexible grade-level coverage and explore a new Alignment tab showing how students develop soft skills and see those skills highlighted on individual student profiles. Plus, Sparky has a refreshed look.


Check out our June updates below 👇


## 📊 New alignment analytics in Flint


Get a clearer view of how students are growing. The new Alignment tab shows Bloom's taxonomy distribution and a soft skills radar. You can filter by any skill to see evidence cards with direct links to the messages where students demonstrated that skill.


You'll also find Pulse insights and demonstration carousels that make it easy to spot patterns and celebrate growth.[Learn more about alignment analytics in Flint.](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/15122879-workspace-analytics-in-flint)


## 🎯 See your mission in action


Ever wonder if Sparky's conversations actually reflect your school's values? Now you can see for yourself. The Alignment tab highlights moments when Sparky's responses embody your Mission & Background or Learning Goals.


You'll also see exemplary teaching moments so you can understand exactly how Sparky supports your educational philosophy.


## 📝 Analysis guidelines for activities


Teachers can now add custom analysis guidelines when setting up an activity. These guidelines tell Sparky how to evaluate student responses making it easier to track specific skills or criteria that matter for your assignment.


## 🔄 Improved follow-up activities


Creating a follow-up activity just got easier. When you create a follow-up from an existing activity, Sparky now remembers the context, including the original activity name, Sparky's role, grade level, and guidelines. No more re-entering details manually.


This makes it simpler to build on what students have already learned and target specific skills that need more practice.[Learn more about follow-up activities.](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/13643224-understanding-activity-analytics-in-flint)


## 🛡️ Flexible moderation for your school


Admins can now assign moderation responsibilities to any staff member and customize coverage by grade level. Each moderator sees alerts only for their assigned grades, so the right people can respond quickly.[Learn more about moderation guidelines in Flint.](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/15033701-moderation-in-flint)


## 💅 A fresh look for Flint


Same Sparky you know and love, now with a fresh coat of polish. We've refined buttons, forms, and menus across the app for a cleaner, more consistent look. Everything works exactly as before: it just looks a little sharper!
